reason: The cited evidence shows that Al+Ti additions to CoNiFe-based FCC HEAs form coherent L12 precipitates and that precipitation strengthening dominates, but none of the studies involve a Ti–Ni primary matrix, the specific 800 °C/1 h aging, or the claimed 20–30% volume fraction and strength increase. The premises about the matrix and quantitative outcomes are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al addition to FCC HEAs can promote coherent L12 precipitates
Aging at ~800 °C for 1 h yields high volume fraction (~20–30%) of γ′
Coherent γ′ precipitates provide significant precipitation strengthening at elevated temperatures
Ti–Ni primary HEA can form an FCC matrix that hosts γ′
The predicted 20–30% yield strength increase is achievable
